hook: A starving songstress searches for the king who will fill her bowl.

word.note: The poet uses this word to describe the upturned begging bowls of hungry artists waiting for a patron.

excerpt: O songstress of few bangles, who sat at the edge of the desert path, carrying your instruments—a large clay drum hanging on one side, and a small hollow-piped drum hanging on the other—wondering, 'Who will turn upright our upturned begging bowls?' If you go to him, he is not far away. He is right there in the enemy's territory, Añci of many spears, where the dark smoke rising from the burning battlefronts wraps around young male elephants like mist surrounding a mountain.
